content: If Dem_GetEventAvailable is called with a valid EventId , it shall set the output value AvailableStatus to the Event's availability and return E_OK. The availability is determined by the configuration parameter DemEventAvail- able (modifiable through Dem_SetEventAvailable ) and DemEventAvailableCnf ([SWS_Dem_01344] ("Dem shall treat an Event as unavailable...").
